title: TEND canonical_form_set
description: Four-tuple gold-as-class AST membership specification for a record. RAR thin cfs requires the disabled-token set in must_not_contain; must_contain_at_root may be empty.

must_contain.description: Idiom-invariant operators that must appear at any pipeline depth; may be empty.

must_not_contain.description: Operators forbidden at any depth; must contain the six disabled-token guards at minimum.

must_contain_at_root.description: Stage operators required at pipeline root; may be empty under RAR thin cfs.

must_not_contain_at_root.description: Stage operators forbidden at pipeline root.
